reason: Primary purpose is to make tool calls resilient to redundant sandbox permission escalation requests by sanitizing non-expansive sandbox_permissions before validation while letting genuine escalations continue through normal approval flow. Classification is plugin-development because it is packaged and loaded as a Cordis plugin extension with explicit event-hook behavior over tool execution.

summaries.zh: 该插件用于在工具执行时处理冗余的 sandbox_permissions 请求：当权限请求未实际升级时将其清理后按当前会话权限执行，避免因重复字段导致的调用失败。
summaries.en: This plugin handles redundant sandbox permission escalation fields during tool execution by removing non-escalating requests so calls run at current session permissions without being rejected, while preserving normal handling for genuine permission escalations.

capabilities: Intercepts tool execution arguments on tools/execute
Keeps escalation path unchanged for wider permission requests

reasons.code: Plugin listens on tools/execute, inspects sandbox_permissions, and removes sandbox_permissions/justification when the requested mode is not strictly wider than session mode.
Uses a Cordis patch entry and plugin package metadata (dsh.bundle.patch) for bundle registration and plugin activation.
